pause.title: Pause source
pause.body: Subscriptions stop but the session is kept. When resumed, messages queued at the broker are received first.

archive.title: Archive source
archive.body: Disconnects and makes the settings read-only. An archived source cannot be reactivated (clone it instead).

delete.title: Delete source
delete.body: A source can be deleted only when no devices are linked. This cannot be undone.

clone.title: Clone source
clone.body: Copies the settings into a new draft. Secrets and devices are not copied.

confirm.typeCode: Type the source code {{code}} to confirm
confirm.mismatch: The code you typed does not match the source code.

list.title: Data sources
list.name: Name / code
list.emptyBody: Connect a data source to receive sensor data.
list.emptyAskAdmin: Ask an administrator (INTEGRATOR or above) to connect a source.

new.title: New data source
new.unsupported: This connector cannot be created from the screen yet. Use MQTT subscription, platform broker or simulation.

edit.title: {{name}} settings
edit.saved: Saved. If the source is active, only this source reconnects.

catalog.fallback: Could not load the connector catalog. You can still use the basic types.

form.readOnly: Read-only. Only INTEGRATOR or above can change settings.
form.conflict: Someone else changed this source first. Refresh to see the latest settings, then save again.
form.codeHint: Starts with a lowercase letter; lowercase, digits and - up to 50. Cannot be changed later
form.name: Name
form.tlsInsecureWarn: Without verification the connection is exposed to man-in-the-middle attacks. Use only for development sources.
form.platformEndpoint: The endpoint is fixed by the platform: wss://iot-data.java21.net/mqtt
form.scenarioHint: The simulator feeds data through this source
form.secretKeep: Leave empty to keep the current value
form.secretWriteOnly: After saving, only a 4-character fingerprint is shown
form.sharedGroupHint: If set, the actual topic becomes $share/{group}/…
form.decoderChangeHint: A decoder change applies to messages processed afterwards. Reprocess earlier messages if needed.
form.reconnectHint: For an active source, only this source reconnects.

validation.code: Up to 50 characters starting with a lowercase letter (lowercase, digits, -)
validation.name: Enter a name of 1–100 characters
validation.clientId: client-id must be 1–100 letters, digits, - or _
validation.sessionExpiry: Session expiry must be a non-negative integer

mapping.title: generic-json mapping
mapping.timeHint: epoch ms or ISO-8601. Empty means received time

test.title: Connection test
test.idle: Press [Test connection] to see each step and up to 10 recent messages. Results are not saved.
test.partial: Partial success: subscribed but no messages arrived. Check the topics and QoS.
test.failed: The connection test failed. Check the cause at the failed step.
test.lossPossible: With these settings messages may be lost on failure (QoS 0).

live.rate: Shows up to 10 messages per second
live.emptyBody: While the source is active, new messages appear here immediately.

detail.noInstancesBody: After activation the platform connects within 1 minute.

ignore.emptyBody: Devices rejected in pending approval appear here.

credentials.title: Platform broker credentials
credentials.issueBody: Creates a password and a signing key. They are shown only once.
credentials.perDevice: Per-device credentials are issued and revoked in the device's Credentials tab.
credentials.onceTitle: Shown only now. Enter it into the device, then close.
credentials.emptyBody: Use [Issue] to create this device's credentials.
credentials.askAdmin: Ask an administrator (INTEGRATOR or above) to issue one.
credentials.revokeBody: Revokes {{username}}. This cannot be undone. Signature rejection takes effect within 1 minute.

errors.SOURCE_CODE_DUPLICATE: A source with the same code already exists.
errors.SOURCE_CLIENT_ID_DUPLICATE: Another source uses the same client-id.
errors.SOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The organization source limit (50) was exceeded.
errors.SOURCE_STATE_CONFLICT: This action is not allowed in the current state.
errors.SOURCE_IN_USE: Devices are linked, so the source cannot be deleted.
errors.SOURCE_AUTH_UNSUPPORTED: This connector does not support the authentication method.
errors.SOURCE_TLS_VERIFY_REQUIRED: Production sources cannot skip TLS verification.
errors.SOURCE_ROTATION_FAILED: Credential rotation failed; the previous value is kept.
